sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: OPA Gatekeeper：約束模板與政策單元測試
related.titleEn: OPA Gatekeeper: constraint templates and policy unit tests
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付50物件評估清單、正負樣本、推出門檻與回退驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver fifty evaluations, positive and negative fixtures, rollout gates and rollback validation.
related.difference: 區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 違規比例=違規的適用物件/已評估適用物件；Audit記錄違規通常不等於拒絕請求。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成命名空間有50個適用物件，10個缺少team標籤；政策先以稽核方式觀察。 違規率10/50=20%，通過率80%。
測試通過率=與人工預期相符的判定/全部測試；測試覆蓋仍取決於案例品質。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 16個合成物件測試，14個符合預期，2個缺欄位案例被錯誤允許。 通過率14/16=87.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Violation rate uses evaluated applicable objects; Audit recording does not itself mean admission rejection. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic namespace has fifty applicable objects, ten lacking a team label; start in audit mode. Violation rate=10/50=20%, with 80% passing.

Test pass rate is decisions matching manual expectations divided by all tests; coverage still depends on fixture quality. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Sixteen synthetic object tests yield fourteen expected decisions; two missing-field cases are incorrectly allowed. Pass rate=14/16=87.5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenTelemetry Collector：敏感欄位移除與觀測保留
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry Collector: redaction while retaining observability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付50物件評估清單、正負樣本、推出門檻與回退驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver fifty evaluations, positive and negative fixtures, rollout gates and rollback validation.
related.difference: 畫出receiver、processor、exporter的資料路徑，確認所有輸出分支都經過必要遮罩或刪除。
related.differenceEn: Map receiver, processor and exporter paths, confirming every output branch passes required redaction or deletion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 違規比例=違規的適用物件/已評估適用物件；Audit記錄違規通常不等於拒絕請求。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成命名空間有50個適用物件，10個缺少team標籤；政策先以稽核方式觀察。 違規率10/50=20%，通過率80%。
移除完整率=已正確移除的敏感欄位/所有標記敏感欄位；還要另測必要追蹤欄位是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100筆合成事件各含2個敏感欄位，共200個；目前正確移除190個。 完整率190/200=95%，仍殘留10個假敏感欄位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Violation rate uses evaluated applicable objects; Audit recording does not itself mean admission rejection. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic namespace has fifty applicable objects, ten lacking a team label; start in audit mode. Violation rate=10/50=20%, with 80% passing.

Redaction completeness is correctly removed sensitive fields over all labeled sensitive fields; separately verify useful trace fields remain. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. One hundred synthetic events each contain two sensitive fields, totaling two hundred; 190 are correctly removed. Completeness=190/200=95%, leaving ten fake sensitive fields.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
